info.title: Kenya Land Valuation API
info.description: Backend API for the Kenya land valuation app.  Provides price-per-acre predictions, market insights, and model explainability for Kenyan land parcels.

get.description:
Liveness + readiness probe.

Returns ``status: ok`` when all artifacts are loaded **and** the model
registry successfully loaded the ensemble (so ``/api/v1/predict`` is
usable).  ``degraded`` covers two cases:

1. The ``ArtifactRegistry`` (B0) found a missing top-level file
   (``xgb_model.json``, ``preprocessing.json``, …).
2. The ``ModelRegistry`` (this phase) raised ``ModelLoadError`` —
   typically because ``serving_manifest.json`` or one of the model
   files it lists is missing, or because the feature pipeline's
   ``scoring_params.json`` / ``reference_data.json`` /
   ``feature_manifest.json`` are absent.

In both cases the app still starts so ``/docs`` and the test suite
work without the large model files.

Return lightweight artifact metadata + FX + canonical copy blocks.

When artifacts are not loaded (degraded mode) the model_version /
data_date / coverage / ensemble_weights fields are ``null``.  The FX
block comes from settings (env), NOT artifacts — but there is no
default rate in code, so it too is ``null`` until the operator
configures one.  ``flag_definition`` and ``methodology`` are code
constants and are always served.

post.description:
Predict the price per acre of a Kenyan land parcel.

Returns 503 ``MODEL_NOT_LOADED`` when the ensemble is not loaded
(degraded mode — copy the artefacts into ``ARTIFACTS_DIR`` and restart).
The live explanation and comparables blocks are added when their
respective services are available; they degrade to ``null`` / ``[]``
independently (e.g. when ``listings_scored.parquet`` is missing the
prediction still returns, just without comparables).

get.description:
One row per county (optionally filtered by prop_type), plus the
canonical property-type list, data-driven price bands, and the
min_county_n threshold from the artifact config.

**Filtering:** when ``prop_type`` is set, the per-county aggregates
are recomputed from the filtered ``listings_scored`` frame (the
pre-aggregated ``county_summary.csv`` cannot be filtered).  The two
paths agree on the shared columns; the frame path leaves
``water_body_distance_share`` null (that column is notebook-only).

**Price bands (P3b):** the band edges are quintiles of the medians
of the counties that meet ``min_county_n`` — equal county-frequency
bands, recomputed when the filter changes so the legend always
matches the map.

parameters.name: prop_type

schema.description: Case-insensitive EXACT match against one of the canonical property types (Land, Farm, Commercial).  Unknown -> 422 with `allowed`.  When set, per-county aggregates are computed on the filtered rows of listings_scored.parquet.
schema.title: Prop Type

parameters.description: Case-insensitive EXACT match against one of the canonical property types (Land, Farm, Commercial).  Unknown -> 422 with `allowed`.  When set, per-county aggregates are computed on the filtered rows of listings_scored.parquet.

get.description:
Whole-county distance profile (P3b): n, ranges, server-side OLS
trend on log(price) vs distance-to-Nairobi, and a deterministic
UNBIASED sample of the county's rows (never head()/first-N of a
sorted frame — the frame is sorted most-underpriced-first, so a
page-based sample would be biased).

A county below ``min_county_n`` returns the data but sets
``low_support: true`` and omits the trend (null) so the UI can show a
"limited data" note instead of a misleading line.

Simplified GeoJSON of Kenya's 47 county boundaries for the choropleth.

Returns the raw GeoJSON (cached at startup).  The GeoJSON is simplified
via Douglas-Peucker (tolerance reported in the manifest) to keep the
file light for page-load rendering.

get.description:
Per-county listing counts from ``listings_scored.parquet`` — for the
scatter-plot tab's county picker + the "N listings" label.

This does NOT return medians (those come from /counties/summary).  It
only reports how many listings each county has in the per-listing
endpoint's backing frame, so the frontend can warn when a county's
coverage is thin.

Per-listing scatter-plot data for one county.

Returns ``price_per_acre_ksh``, ``dist_to_nairobi_km`` (recomputed from
lat/lon via B1's haversine), ``size_acres``, and ``verdict`` for each
listing in the county.  Backed by ``listings_scored.parquet`` (Cell 9.6)
— the only export that carries ``listed_price_per_acre_ksh`` +
``size_acres`` together.  The prediction parquets (oof/test) lack
``size_acres`` and only carry ``y_true`` (log scale), not the asking
price per acre.

**Medians / IQR for the ranked list and deep-dive cards come from
/counties/summary (county_summary.csv) — this endpoint does NOT
recompute them.**

CV + test metrics with bootstrap CIs, ensemble weights, interval coverage.

P5b additions: ``ensemble_model`` (the production run's ensemble row,
identified by the backend — the frontend resolves the row by this
value only, no substring heuristics), ``production_run_label``,
``interval_levels`` (derived from the data — see the schema),
``default_interval_level``, ``interval_method`` (documented backend
constant), ``n_test`` / ``n_dev`` (row counts of the loaded
prediction parquets), and ``model_info`` (per-model display_name +
family from the backend's documented registry mapping).
Phase 3 ranked feature table (Cell 3.8, written by Cell 9.3).

Global mean-|SHAP| + native & permutation importance + feature labels.

P6b additions: ``models`` (the ensemble member list with display names,
families, weights and a has_shap flag) + ``default_model``; the
``ensemble_shap_coverage`` block is now normalised to fractions with a
``source`` flag — recomputed from the actually-loaded ensemble's weights
when the model registry is loaded (the same shared computation the live
/predict coverage block uses), else the notebook-time manifest values;
``typical_price_per_acre_ksh`` / ``combined_base_value`` carry the
load-time baseline when the explanation service is available.

Per-listing actual vs. predicted values for both splits.

Returns both the development-set out-of-fold predictions and the test-set
predictions in one payload.  Each row carries the identifier columns
(listing_url, listing_no, county, prop_type, etc.) so the frontend can
link a scatter point back to its listing.

parameters.description: If set, return a deterministic random sample of this many rows from each split (oof + test) rather than every row.  Useful for scatter plots where the full row count would be wasteful.  The sample is deterministic (seed=42) so the same request always returns the same rows.

- ``nearby_within_50km``: error by the number of listings within 50km

get.description:
Streaming CSV of every row matching the current filters.

- Same filter/sort semantics as /listings/scored (single source of
  truth — the same validation code path runs).
- Header row, UTF-8 with BOM (Excel-friendly); money columns are raw
  KSh numbers so Excel can sum them.
- A row cap ONLY when configured via the ``LISTINGS_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS``
  setting (default: no cap).  When the cap truncates the export, the
  response carries ``X-Export-Truncated: true`` and
  ``X-Export-Total`` headers rather than silently cutting.
- ``Content-Disposition`` filename is built from the active filters.

schema.description: Part B suspect gate: true/false/absent (same as /listings/scored)
schema.title: Is Suspect

get.description:
Log-scale price histogram + percentiles over the usable listings.

``flag_definition`` (P7b) carries the flagged-listing rule (the
percentile window from the canonical constants) so the frontend can
explain what "flagged as possible errors" means without typing
"1st–99th".

Per-group price-per-acre summary over the usable frame.

Groups come from the canonical ``PROPERTY_TYPES`` list
(``group=prop_type``) or the canonical ``SIZE_BANDS_ACRES`` edges
(``group=size_band``) — the router never invents a group.  Groups with
fewer than ``MIN_GROUP_N`` usable listings return null stats and
``insufficient=True`` (an honest "not enough data" rather than a noisy
median on two rows); ``n`` is always the real count.

parameters.name: include_suspect

schema.description: Include suspect listings (default: exclude, as the Deal Finder corpus does)
schema.title: Include Suspect

parameters.description: Include suspect listings (default: exclude, as the Deal Finder corpus does)

get.description:
size_acres vs listed price/acre over the usable frame.

Returns:

- ``spearman_rho`` — ``df.corr(method='spearman')`` over the FULL
  usable frame (not the sample);
- ``deciles`` — 10 equal-count log-size bins of the usable frame, each
  with its median listed price/acre + count;
- ``sample`` — a DETERMINISTIC uniform random sample of
  ``RELATIONSHIPS_SAMPLE_N`` usable rows (seeded; never top-N or
  first-N) carrying listing_no, size_acres, listed_price_per_acre_ksh,
  is_suspect, data_quality_flag.

Usable = finite size_acres AND finite, strictly-positive listed
price/acre.  Suspects are INCLUDED (the scatter's "hide suspect" toggle
is a client-side filter; the backend returns the full picture so the
toggle can show/hide without a refetch).
Read-only summary for the Overview page.

get.description: Read-only options for the Predictor form.

ByDistanceBandBlock.title: ByDistanceBandBlock
ByDistanceBandBlock.description:
Per-band median + IQR for the filtered selection, used by the chart's
band overlay + the pinned tooltip card.

types.title: Types
types.description: One row per canonical type, in PROPERTY_TYPES order

leader.title: Leader
leader.description: Canonical type with the highest median.  Null when fewer than 2 types have data (no comparison possible).

leader_premium_pct.title: Leader Premium Pct
leader_premium_pct.description: (leader_median - median_of_all_other_types_with_data) / median_of_all_other_types_with_data * 100, rounded to 1 decimal. Positive means the leader is more expensive per acre than the combined median of the other types with data.  Null when fewer than 2 types have data.

ByPropertyTypeBlock.title: ByPropertyTypeBlock
ByPropertyTypeBlock.description:
The three canonical type bars + the leader summary that feeds the
footer line ``<Leader> leads premium by +X%``.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: National series for the same bands, only present when a county filter is applied (so the chart can draw the dashed benchmark).

bulk_discount_pct.title: Bulk Discount Pct
bulk_discount_pct.description: Percentage drop in median per acre from the smallest populated band to the largest populated band: (smallest_median - largest_median) / smallest_median * 100, rounded to 1 decimal.  Null when fewer than 2 bands have a median (i.e. fewer than 2 populated bands).

BySizeBandBlock.title: BySizeBandBlock
BySizeBandBlock.description:
The size-band series for the filtered selection (county-filtered if
a county is selected, otherwise national) plus, when a county is
selected, a ``comparison`` series for the national view so the chart
can draw both lines.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Haversine distance from the predicted point

ComparableListingResponse.title: ComparableListingResponse
ComparableListingResponse.description:
One nearby listing returned as a comparable.

Note: ``list_date`` / ``days_ago`` is intentionally OMITTED — Notebook
1's ``list_date`` is empty for every listing, so fabricating a value
would mislead the user.  See the comparables.py docstring.

top_n.title: Top N
top_n.description: The N used (query param top_n_counties, default 3)

CountiesBlock.title: CountiesBlock
CountiesBlock.description: Top-N counties by listing count + the combined ``Others`` entry.

n.title: N
n.description: Total rows in the county (after filter)

distance_range_km.title: Distance Range Km
distance_range_km.description: [min, max] distance-to-Nairobi over the county's rows

n_total.title: N Total
n_total.description: Total rows the sample was drawn from

CountyDistanceProfileResponse.title: CountyDistanceProfileResponse
CountyDistanceProfileResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/counties/{county}/distance-profile response.

``low_support`` is true when the county is below min_county_n — the
rows/sample are still returned but ``trend`` is omitted (null) so
the UI can show a "limited data" note instead of a misleading line.

dist_to_nairobi_km.title: Dist To Nairobi Km
dist_to_nairobi_km.description: Haversine distance to Nairobi CBD (recomputed from lat/lon via B1's haversine_km_vectorised — Cell 4.2's formula, same earth radius 6371.0 km).  Null when the listing's coordinates are missing.

CountyListingScatterRow.title: CountyListingScatterRow
CountyListingScatterRow.description:
One row of GET /api/v1/counties/{county}/listings — the scatter-plot fields.

``listed_price_per_acre_ksh`` and ``size_acres`` come directly from
``listings_scored.parquet`` (Cell 9.6).  ``dist_to_nairobi_km`` is
recomputed from the stored lat/lon via B1's haversine — the raw column
didn't survive into the export (Cell 9.6 only carries ID_COLUMNS +
price columns, not feature columns).

CountyRowCount.title: CountyRowCount
CountyRowCount.description: One row of GET /api/v1/counties/row_counts — county name + listing count.

CountyStat.title: CountyStat
CountyStat.description: One named county row in the top-N list.

min_county_n.title: Min County N
min_county_n.description: CONFIG.MIN_COUNTY_N from the manifest; null when missing

CountySummaryResponse.title: CountySummaryResponse
CountySummaryResponse.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/counties/summary.

P3b additions (all additive / nullable):
- ``prop_type`` — echo of the applied canonical filter.
- ``property_types`` — canonical list with corpus-level counts.
- ``price_bands`` + ``bands_reason`` — the colour-band edges as data
  (quintiles of the county medians of min_county_n-eligible
  counties).  ``price_bands`` is empty and ``bands_reason`` explains
  why when there are fewer eligible counties than bands.
- ``min_county_n`` — from the manifest config; null (with
  ``data_quality="min_county_n_missing"``) when the config lacks it.
- ``n_counties_with_data`` / ``n_counties_total`` — from the
  boundaries service (not a literal).
- ``unmapped_prop_type_rows`` — corpus rows whose prop_type is not
  canonical (never silently dropped).

n_suspect.title: N Suspect
n_suspect.description: Suspect listings in this county (Part B gate); null when the scored frame is unavailable

share_suspect.title: Share Suspect
share_suspect.description: n_suspect / n_listings; null when n_listings is 0 or the scored frame is unavailable

CountySummaryRow.title: CountySummaryRow
CountySummaryRow.description:
One county's aggregate row (CSV path or frame path).

``water_body_distance_share`` is only populated on the unfiltered
CSV path (the notebook's column); the frame path leaves it null.
``n_below_min_county_n`` is null when the threshold itself is
unavailable (see CountySummaryResponse.data_quality).  The price
fields are null when the county has no usable rows under the
current filter (never a fabricated 0).

upper_km.title: Upper Km
upper_km.description: Upper edge (km); ``null`` for the final open-ended band ('400+ km').

DistanceBand.title: DistanceBand
DistanceBand.description: One corridor on the Price-by-distance-from-Nairobi band overlay.

DistanceProfilePoint.title: DistanceProfilePoint
DistanceProfilePoint.description: One point of the deterministic unbiased sample.

slope.title: Slope
slope.description: Slope per km; null when <2 rows

DistanceProfileTrend.title: DistanceProfileTrend
DistanceProfileTrend.description:
Server-side OLS fit of log(price per acre) on distance-to-Nairobi,
over ALL rows of the county (not a page).

DriverContributionResponse.title: DriverContributionResponse
DriverContributionResponse.description:
One feature's contribution to the prediction.

The SHAP value is on the log scale (log KSh per acre).  The effect %
follows explain_spec.md's rule (Cell 9.10):

    effect(f) = exp(s_f) - 1   (multiplicative change in typical price
                                per acre attributable to feature f)

tree_share_explained_by_shap.title: Tree Share Explained By Shap
tree_share_explained_by_shap.description: Sum of tree-member (xgb + catboost) weights in the loaded ensemble

tabnet_share_not_covered.title: Tabnet Share Not Covered
tabnet_share_not_covered.description: TabNet's weight in the loaded ensemble (0 if pruned). The TabNet share of the blend is NOT covered by SHAP.

explained_members.title: Explained Members
explained_members.description: Which members the SHAP values cover (xgb, catboost)

unexplained_members.title: Unexplained Members
unexplained_members.description: Which members are NOT covered (tabnet, if loaded)

combined_base_value.title: Combined Base Value
combined_base_value.description: Combined base value on the log scale (weighted sum of member base values)

typical_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Typical Price Per Acre Ksh
typical_price_per_acre_ksh.description: exp(combined_base_value) — the typical KSh per acre before per-feature adjustments

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency of this request's live SHAP computation. TreeExplainer is built once (cached for the process); shap_values on a single row is typically sub-millisecond to a few ms.

EnsembleShapCoverage.title: EnsembleShapCoverage
EnsembleShapCoverage.description:
Recomputed from whichever members actually got loaded (post-pruning),
NOT the notebook's static manifest values.

support_measures.title: Support Measures
support_measures.description: The distinct support_measure groups present, in first-appearance order, with i18n label keys (P5b).

n_listings.title: N Listings
n_listings.description: Count of listings in that band

oof_rmse.title: Oof Rmse
oof_rmse.description: OOF RMSE for that band (log scale)

oof_mae.title: Oof Mae
oof_mae.description: OOF MAE for that band (log scale)

band_order.title: Band Order
band_order.description: Ascending ordinal within the support_measure group (0 = lowest band)

ErrorBySupportRow.title: ErrorBySupportRow
ErrorBySupportRow.description:
One row from error_by_support.csv.

``band_order`` (P5b, additive): the ascending ordinal of the band
within its ``support_measure`` group (0 = lowest support band), so
the UI sorts by it instead of parsing band strings like
``"<10 (below COVERAGE_MIN_COUNTY_N)"`` or ``"50+"``.  Derived by
parsing the leading number in the band label; ties keep CSV order.

The band label itself is served VERBATIM from the notebook's export
(Cell 9.9) — the frontend displays it as-is and never re-derives
any embedded threshold.

tree_share_explained_by_shap.title: Tree Share Explained By Shap
tree_share_explained_by_shap.description: Fraction in [0,1] of the ensemble blend the SHAP values explain.

tabnet_share_not_covered.title: Tabnet Share Not Covered
tabnet_share_not_covered.description: Fraction in [0,1] of the blend SHAP does NOT explain (kept for name compatibility — the share of every non-tree member, 0 when none are kept).

explained_members.title: Explained Members
explained_members.description: Kept members the SHAP values cover (source='recomputed' only).

unexplained_members.title: Unexplained Members
unexplained_members.description: Kept members SHAP does not cover (source='recomputed' only).

note.title: Note
note.description: The notebook's explanatory note, passed through when present.

ExplainabilityCoverage.title: ExplainabilityCoverage
ExplainabilityCoverage.description:
The ``ensemble_shap_coverage`` block on the explainability payload
(P6b) — normalised to FRACTIONS in [0, 1] with documented keys, plus the
``source`` flag so the UI can say where the numbers come from.

- ``source="recomputed"`` — computed by the backend from the weights of
  the actually-loaded (post-pruning, renormalised) ensemble via the ONE
  shared function (``landval.modelling.coverage``).  ``explained_members``
  / ``unexplained_members`` list the real kept members in this case.
- ``source="manifest"`` — the notebook-time values from
  ``manifest.json:ensemble_shap_coverage`` (pre-pruning), normalised to
  fractions (values above 1 are treated as percentages).  Members are
  ``None`` in this case: the manifest does not record them, and the
  backend never invents member names.
- ``source=None`` — neither path produced shares (e.g. the manifest block
  is absent and the model registry is not loaded).

key.title: Key
key.description: Member key exactly as the data uses it ('xgb', 'catboost', 'tabnet')

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable name from the backend model registry mapping

family.title: Family
family.description: 'tree' / 'neural' / 'ensemble' / 'baseline' from the backend mapping; null for unknown keys

ensemble_weight.title: Ensemble Weight
ensemble_weight.description: Weight in the loaded ensemble; null when the registry is not loaded

has_shap.title: Has Shap
has_shap.description: True when the member has rows in shap_global.csv

ExplainabilityModel.title: ExplainabilityModel
ExplainabilityModel.description:
One ensemble member on the explainability payload (P6b).

``ensemble_weight`` is the member's weight in the loaded (renormalised)
ensemble — ``None`` when the model registry is not loaded.  ``has_shap``
is True when the member has rows in ``shap_global.csv`` (i.e. the bars
card can chart it).  ``display_name`` / ``family`` come from the
backend's documented model registry mapping (``app.schemas.canonical.
MODEL_INFO``) so the frontend never re-types them.

ExplainabilityResponse.title: ExplainabilityResponse
ExplainabilityResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/model/explainability — combines shap_global,
feature_importance and feature_labels in one payload so the tab can
render the global-importance chart and the plain-English feature
labels in a single round-trip.

P6b additions (all nullable / defaulting, additive — older payloads
without them still validate):
- ``models`` — the ensemble member list (key, display_name, family,
  ensemble_weight, has_shap), ordered by ensemble weight descending.
  Built from the loaded registry when available, else from the
  distinct models in shap_global.csv (weights null).
- ``default_model`` — the SHAP-covered member with the highest
  ensemble weight (the bars card's default selection); the first
  SHAP-covered member in file order when no weights are available;
  null when no member has SHAP rows.
- ``ensemble_shap_coverage`` — see ``ExplainabilityCoverage``.
- ``typical_price_per_acre_ksh`` / ``combined_base_value`` — the
  load-time baseline price (exp of the weighted sum of tree-member
  base values — the SAME baseline every /predict response reports).
  Null when the model registry / explanation service is unavailable
  (never invented).

missing_%.title: Missing %
missing_%.description: Share of dev-set rows with the feature missing (%)

mutual_info.title: Mutual Info
mutual_info.description: Mutual information vs the target; NaN when not computed.

perm_delta_rmse.title: Perm Delta Rmse
perm_delta_rmse.description: Permutation importance — RMSE increase when the feature is shuffled within the dev fold (Cell 3.6).

mean_abs_shap.title: Mean Abs Shap
mean_abs_shap.description: Mean |SHAP| on the dev set; NaN for non-tree-screened features.

selection_votes.title: Selection Votes
selection_votes.description: Votes across the Phase 3 selection methods

FeatureEvaluationRow.title: FeatureEvaluationRow
FeatureEvaluationRow.description:
One row of ``feature_evaluation.csv`` — Cell 3.8's ``ranked_table``,
written out by Cell 9.3.  Every value is on the development set.

method.title: Method
method.description: xgb = gain; catboost = PredictionValuesChange (or 'mean_abs_shap (fallback; ...)' when the native importance is unavailable on a loaded model); tabnet = permutation on the development set (5 shuffles, seed from manifest.config.SEED).

FeatureImportanceRow.title: FeatureImportanceRow
FeatureImportanceRow.description:
One row of ``feature_importance.csv`` — Cell 9.4 builds one row per
(model, feature) pair for all three models, with ``method`` recording
how the importance was computed.

property_types.title: Property Types
property_types.description: Canonical property types with per-type row counts under the current county filter

FiltersBlock.title: FiltersBlock
FiltersBlock.description:
Echo of the applied county / prop_type filters, plus the canonical
property-type list with the per-type row count under the CURRENT
county filter so the Overview dropdown can be rendered from data.

lower_pct.title: Lower Pct
lower_pct.description: Lower percentile of the flag window

upper_pct.title: Upper Pct
upper_pct.description: Upper percentile of the flag window

FlagDefinition.title: FlagDefinition
FlagDefinition.description:
The data-quality-flag percentile window (P7b/P8b).

Served on ``/meta`` and ``/data/price-distribution`` from the canonical
``FLAG_LOWER_PCT`` / ``FLAG_UPPER_PCT`` constants so the UI can say
"flagged = outside the {{lower}}th–{{upper}}th percentile window"
without ever typing "1st–99th".

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date the operator set the rate (free-form).

source.title: Source
source.description: Who maintains the rate — distinguishes a manually-maintained rate from a live feed.

FxBlock.title: FxBlock
FxBlock.description:
KSh↔USD conversion block served by /meta (P8b).

``ksh_per_usd`` is the configured rate (1 USD = N KSh).  There is NO
default rate in code: when ``FX_KSH_PER_USD`` is unset the whole block
is ``null`` and the frontend disables its USD toggle (an honest
"not available" state) rather than guessing a rate.

``as_of`` — free-form date the operator set the rate ("YYYY-MM-DD"
recommended).  ``source`` — who maintains the rate (e.g. "manually
maintained via FX_KSH_PER_USD"; a live FX feed would set its provider
name here).  A live feed is NOT part of this task; the block is
operator-configured by design.

artifacts_loaded.title: Artifacts Loaded
artifacts_loaded.description: True when all expected artifact files are present

ListingsCountyOption.title: ListingsCountyOption
ListingsCountyOption.description: Exact county name (the filter accepts this string verbatim) + count.

unmapped_prop_type_rows.title: Unmapped Prop Type Rows
unmapped_prop_type_rows.description: Corpus rows whose prop_type is not canonical (never silently dropped)

amenity_filter_available.title: Amenity Filter Available
amenity_filter_available.description: False when the POI / roads spatial data is missing — the UI disables the amenity control with a reason instead of the filter failing with 503 at click time.

export_max_rows.title: Export Max Rows
export_max_rows.description: Server-side export row cap (from the LISTINGS_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS setting); null = uncapped.

ListingsPropertyType.title: ListingsPropertyType
ListingsPropertyType.description: Canonical property type + its row count in the corpus.

listed_over_predicted.title: Listed Over Predicted
listed_over_predicted.description: Listed / predicted ratio (>1 = listed above model)

data_quality_flag.title: Data Quality Flag
data_quality_flag.description: True when the listing's log price per acre falls outside the development target's 1st-99th percentile window (Cell 9.6).

is_suspect.title: Is Suspect
is_suspect.description: Part B suspect-listing gate (computed at serve time, never written to artifacts).  True when listed_over_predicted falls outside [SUSPECT_RATIO_LOW, SUSPECT_RATIO_HIGH] or size_acres is non-finite / non-positive.  Suspects are excluded from the underpriced/fair/overpriced corpus counts and reported separately as n_suspect.

suspect_reason.title: Suspect Reason
suspect_reason.description: One of 'listed_far_below_model', 'listed_far_above_model', 'non_finite_size', or null when the row is not suspect.

ListingsScoredRow.title: ListingsScoredRow
ListingsScoredRow.description:
One row of ``listings_scored.parquet`` — Cell 9.6.

The identifier columns (Cell 9.2's ``ID_COLUMNS``) plus the size,
the listed / predicted / low / high per-acre prices, the
listed-over-predicted ratio, the scored-by tag (oof / test), the
verdict (underpriced / overpriced / fair) and a data-quality flag.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: Top N drivers sorted by |shap_value| descending

LiveExplanationResponse.title: LiveExplanationResponse
LiveExplanationResponse.description: The driver breakdown + recomputed shares for one prediction.

fx.description: KSh↔USD conversion rate + its 'as of' date + source.  Null when the operator hasn't configured FX_KSH_PER_USD.  NOT a live feed.

flag_definition.description: The flagged-listing rule: prices outside the lower–upper percentile window carry data_quality_flag = true.  Always served (a code constant, not artifact-derived); nullable for schema-level backward compatibility.

methodology.description: One-sentence data-sources note + the verifiable cleaning steps + the production feature groups.  Served from the canonical methodology copy; rendered by the About page.

sources_note.title: Sources Note
sources_note.description: Where the listings come from (one sentence).

cleaning_steps.title: Cleaning Steps
cleaning_steps.description: Verifiable cleaning steps, in pipeline order.

feature_groups.title: Feature Groups
feature_groups.description: The production feature groups in plain language.

MethodologyBlock.title: MethodologyBlock
MethodologyBlock.description:
Plain-language methodology copy served by ``/meta`` (P8b).

One backend place (``app.schemas.canonical.METHODOLOGY``) for the
data-sources note, the verifiable cleaning steps, and the feature
groups.  The About page renders from this block instead of keeping
its own pipeline copy; every claim is verifiable in the repo (see
the canonical module's comment).

MetricsJsonResponse.title: MetricsJsonResponse
MetricsJsonResponse.description:
The ``metrics.json`` half of GET /api/v1/model/metrics — returned
verbatim (the file's structure is nested and stable, so exposing it
as a free-form dict keeps the endpoint faithful to the notebook).

MetricsResponse.title: MetricsResponse
MetricsResponse.description:
Full GET /api/v1/model/metrics response — table + JSON together.

P5b additions (all nullable, additive):
- ``ensemble_model`` — the production run's ensemble row's model
  name (identified by the backend), null when no such row exists.
  The frontend resolves the ensemble row by THIS value only (no
  substring/heuristic fallbacks).
- ``production_run_label`` — the production run's name + created
  date from the response, for the card subtitle.
- ``interval_levels`` — the nominal interval coverage levels present
  in the data: derived from
  ``metrics_json.interval_coverage_weighted_ensemble[*].level`` when
  the artifact carries them; else from the ensemble row's populated
  ``interval_coverage_*`` columns; else null.
- ``interval_method`` — documented backend constant describing the
  interval implementation (the modeling code implements the
  multiplicative split-conformal interval — see
  ``src/landval/modelling/predict.py``); null when unknown.
- ``n_test`` / ``n_dev`` — row counts of the loaded prediction
  parquets (test_predictions / oof_predictions); null when the file
  is not loaded.
- ``model_info`` — per-model ``display_name`` + ``family`` from the
  backend's documented model registry mapping (facts about the
  model implementations, not UI copy).
- ``default_interval_level`` — the app's standard level (the same
  canonical constant the predict options endpoint serves).

MetricsTableResponse.title: MetricsTableResponse
MetricsTableResponse.description: Response for the table half of GET /api/v1/model/metrics.

county_group_cv_rmse.title: County Group Cv Rmse
county_group_cv_rmse.description: County-grouped CV RMSE; NaN for models without one.

ensemble_weight.title: Ensemble Weight
ensemble_weight.description: Member's ensemble weight; NaN when the model is not in MODEL_ORDER.

MetricsTableRow.title: MetricsTableRow
MetricsTableRow.description:
One row of ``metrics_table.csv`` — Cell 9.3 writes one row per
(run, model) pair.  The production run's ``weighted_ensemble`` row
also carries the trimmed-test result and interval_coverage_* fields,
which are optional here because every other row leaves them blank.

oof.title: Oof
oof.description: Development-set out-of-fold predictions (each row predicted by models that never trained on it)

test.title: Test
test.description: Test-set predictions (models fitted on development data only)

oof_count.title: Oof Count
oof_count.description: Total OOF rows in the file (may differ from len(oof) when sampling)

test_count.title: Test Count
test_count.description: Total test rows in the file (may differ from len(test) when sampling)

sampled.title: Sampled
sampled.description: True when a sample parameter was used — the returned rows are a deterministic subset

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: The sample size requested (null when no sampling)

ModelPredictionsResponse.title: ModelPredictionsResponse
ModelPredictionsResponse.description: GET /api/v1/model/predictions response — both OOF + test sets together.

category.title: Category
category.description: hospital / school / market / bank / police / bus_stop / fuel / other

is_fallback.title: Is Fallback
is_fallback.description: True when the name is a generated fallback label ('<category> near <town>') rather than a real OSM name.

NearbyListing.title: NearbyListing
NearbyListing.description: One nearby listing (haversine-nearest, excluding the origin).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: 'no_coordinates' when the origin listing lacks usable lat/lon

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Names of the counties rolled into 'Others'

median_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Price Per Acre Ksh
median_price_per_acre_ksh.description: Median of per-acre prices across all 'Others' rows

OthersBlock.title: OthersBlock
OthersBlock.description:
The combined ``Others`` entry: every county below the top-N cutoff
rolled together so the honeycomb legend can render one summary row.

property_types_canonical.title: Property Types Canonical
property_types_canonical.description: The canonical property-type list (so the frontend never re-types it)

size_band_edges_acres.title: Size Band Edges Acres
size_band_edges_acres.description: Canonical size-band edges (lower edges).  The final edge is ``null`` rather than ``+inf`` so the value is JSON-serialisable; the corresponding label ('20+ ac') communicates the open tail.

size_band_labels.title: Size Band Labels
size_band_labels.description: Human labels for the size bands

distance_band_edges_km.title: Distance Band Edges Km
distance_band_edges_km.description: Canonical distance-band edges (lower edges).  The final edge is ``null`` rather than ``+inf``; the corresponding label ('400+ km') communicates the open tail.

distance_band_labels.title: Distance Band Labels
distance_band_labels.description: Human labels for the distance bands

unmapped_prop_type_rows.title: Unmapped Prop Type Rows
unmapped_prop_type_rows.description: Rows whose prop_type is not in PROPERTY_TYPES.  These are NOT silently dropped or relabelled — the count is surfaced here and logged so the operator can decide to map, exclude, or fix upstream.

national.description: Unfiltered totals (always national, regardless of filters)

n_counties_total.title: N Counties Total
n_counties_total.description: Total county count, from the county boundaries service (or the summary fallback when boundaries are not loaded).  Never a literal.

generated_from.title: Generated From
generated_from.description: Data date (same source /meta uses; null when artifacts are missing)

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: The filters actually applied (echoed for the client).

PaginationMeta.title: PaginationMeta
PaginationMeta.description: Standard pagination block returned by every list endpoint.

place_type.title: Place Type
place_type.description: OSM place tag value (city, town, suburb, ...)

county.title: County
county.description: County (filled by the backend via point-in-polygon; may be null)

is_fallback.title: Is Fallback
is_fallback.description: True when the name is a generated fallback label ('<category> near <town>') rather than a real OSM name.

PredictNamedPOI.title: PredictNamedPOI
PredictNamedPOI.description:
A named POI near the predicted point — for the 'Nearby & Infrastructure' list.

Sourced from kenya_pois_named.gpkg (Cell 5.2's ogr2ogr with `name` added
to the -select list).  POIs without a name in OSM fall back to
'<category> near <nearest town>' — these are labels, not real names.
The ``is_fallback`` flag is True for those fallback labels so the frontend
can style them distinctly (lighter text / "approximate" tag).

property_types.title: Property Types
property_types.description: The canonical property types (Land / Farm / Commercial) with per-type row counts from the loaded frame.  This is THE list the frontend renders — never re-typed.

unmapped_prop_type_rows.title: Unmapped Prop Type Rows
unmapped_prop_type_rows.description: Rows whose prop_type is not in PROPERTY_TYPES.  Counted and logged as a warning; never silently dropped or relabelled.

size_acres.description: Bounds for the parcel-size input, computed from the loaded frame's size_acres column (1st/99th percentile for min/max).

default_confidence_level.title: Default Confidence Level
default_confidence_level.description: The app's standard confidence level (the '80% range').  The frontend uses this as the request's confidence_level when the user hasn't picked a different one.

allowed_confidence_levels.title: Allowed Confidence Levels
allowed_confidence_levels.description: The three pre-calibrated confidence levels the model ships with.  Informational — the request still accepts any value in (0, 1).

parcel_features.title: Parcel Features
parcel_features.description: The ten infrastructure checklist item keys in order.  The frontend iterates this list rather than keeping its own copy. Labels stay in i18n, keyed by these keys ('predictor.feature.borehole' etc.).

property_types_canonical.title: Property Types Canonical
property_types_canonical.description: The canonical property-type list (names only, no counts).

parcel_features.title: Parcel Features
parcel_features.description: Infrastructure checklist. Keys are the ten item names (borehole, piped_water, river_water, water_tank, grid_electric, solar_electric, full_fence, partial_fence, structures, internal_road). Values are true / false / 'not_sure' (or null).

confidence_level.title: Confidence Level
confidence_level.description: Confidence level for the multiplicative conformal interval. 0.50 / 0.80 / 0.90 are pre-calibrated; any value in (0, 1) is accepted (q recomputed from OOF residuals).

ensemble_members.title: Ensemble Members
ensemble_members.description: Which members were actually loaded (post-pruning) and their renormalised weights.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: B1's diagnostics: nearest places, infra source, spatial-index load state.

explanation.description: Live driver breakdown (Cell 9.4 SHAP + Cell 9.10 money-effect rule). Null when no tree models are loaded or the explanation service is unavailable.

comparables.title: Comparables
comparables.description: Nearby listings from listings_scored.parquet within 50 km, ranked by distance.  Empty when listings_scored.parquet is not loaded.

named_pois.title: Named Pois
named_pois.description: Named POIs within 5 km of the predicted point (hospital, school, market, etc.) from kenya_pois_named.gpkg.  Empty when the named-POI layer is not loaded.

PredictResponse.title: PredictResponse
PredictResponse.description:
POST /api/v1/predict response — Cell 8.3 + Cell 9.1 + total + warning
+ live driver breakdown + comparables + named POIs.

pred_simple_average.title: Pred Simple Average
pred_simple_average.description: Simple average of member predictions (log scale)

fold.title: Fold
fold.description: Held-out fold of first CV repeat (-1 for test rows)

PredictionRow.title: PredictionRow
PredictionRow.description: One row from oof_predictions or test_predictions parquet.

upper.title: Upper
upper.description: Upper median edge; null = open top band (>= lower)

PriceBandEdge.title: PriceBandEdge
PriceBandEdge.description:
One colour band edge, computed as a quantile of the county medians
(P3b: bands are DATA, not typed thresholds).

``index`` maps to the frontend's single colour-token map (band 0 =
palest … band N-1 = darkest).  ``upper`` is null for the final open
band (``>= lower``).

PriceBin.title: PriceBin
PriceBin.description:
One histogram bin on the log10 price axis.

``lower_ksh`` / ``upper_ksh`` are the bin edges in KSh per acre
(inclusive-exclusive, except the final bin which includes its upper
edge).  ``count`` is the number of usable listings in the bin.

n_usable.title: N Usable
n_usable.description: Total usable rows the groups were built from

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: One row per canonical group, in canonical order

PriceByGroupResponse.title: PriceByGroupResponse
PriceByGroupResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/data/price-by-group response.

Usable = finite, strictly-positive ``listed_price_per_acre_ksh`` (and
not ``is_suspect`` unless ``include_suspect=true``).  The groups come
from the canonical ``PROPERTY_TYPES`` list (``group=prop_type``) or the
canonical ``SIZE_BANDS_ACRES`` edges (``group=size_band``) — never
invented in the router.  ``min_group_n`` echoes the canonical threshold
so the UI never re-types it.

group.title: Group
group.description: Group label (prop_type value or size-band label key)

insufficient.title: Insufficient
insufficient.description: True when n < MIN_GROUP_N (stats are null)

median_listed_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Listed Per Acre Ksh
median_listed_per_acre_ksh.description: Median listed price per acre (KSh); null when insufficient

p10_listed_per_acre_ksh.title: P10 Listed Per Acre Ksh
p10_listed_per_acre_ksh.description: 10th percentile of listed price per acre (KSh); null when insufficient

p90_listed_per_acre_ksh.title: P90 Listed Per Acre Ksh
p90_listed_per_acre_ksh.description: 90th percentile of listed price per acre (KSh); null when insufficient

median_predicted_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Predicted Per Acre Ksh
median_predicted_per_acre_ksh.description: Median predicted price per acre (KSh); null when insufficient

PriceByGroupRow.title: PriceByGroupRow
PriceByGroupRow.description:
One group's price-per-acre summary.

``insufficient`` is true (and every stat null) when the group has fewer
than ``MIN_GROUP_N`` usable listings — a noisy median on two rows is
worse than an honest "not enough data".  ``n`` is always the real count
(even when insufficient) so the UI can show "n=3, not enough data".

n_usable.title: N Usable
n_usable.description: Usable listings (rows in listings_scored with a finite per-acre price)

n_flagged.title: N Flagged
n_flagged.description: Listings flagged by data_quality_flag (excluded from training)

flag_definition.description: The flag rule (percentile window) from the canonical constants — always served by the router; nullable for schema-level backward compatibility.

PriceDistributionResponse.title: PriceDistributionResponse
PriceDistributionResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/data/price-distribution response.

``n_usable`` powers the Modeling Yield tile; ``n_flagged`` (rows whose
``data_quality_flag`` is true) powers the Sanitization tile.  The raw
pre-cleaning "observed corpus" count is NOT here — that number does not
exist anywhere the backend loads; the frontend marks that tile
unavailable.

``flag_definition`` (P7b) carries the flagged-listing percentile window
(from the canonical constants) so the UI can explain the flag without
typing "1st–99th".

PricePercentiles.title: PricePercentiles
PricePercentiles.description:
Percentile set of the usable per-acre asking prices (KSh).

Web shows p1 / p50 / p99; mobile m12 shows p10 / p50 / p90 — both come
from this single block so the two breakpoints never disagree.

PropertyTypeCount.title: PropertyTypeCount
PropertyTypeCount.description:
One canonical property type + its row count in the corpus (the
dropdown options render from this — the frontend never re-types the
list).

n.title: N
n.description: Rows of this type in the loaded frame

PropertyTypeOption.title: PropertyTypeOption
PropertyTypeOption.description:
One entry in ``property_types`` — the canonical name plus the
row count from the loaded frame.

median_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Price Per Acre Ksh
median_price_per_acre_ksh.description: Null when n=0 (no data for this type)

PropertyTypeStat.title: PropertyTypeStat
PropertyTypeStat.description:
One bar in the Price-by-property-type card.  ``n`` may be 0 (the
frontend renders an empty/muted bar, never a zero-height bar that
reads as a price).

median_listed_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Listed Per Acre Ksh
median_listed_per_acre_ksh.description: Median listed price/acre (KSh); null when n=0

median_size_acres.title: Median Size Acres
median_size_acres.description: Median size (acres) in this decile; null when n=0

RelationshipsDecilePoint.title: RelationshipsDecilePoint
RelationshipsDecilePoint.description: Median listed price/acre for one log-size decile of the usable frame.

n_usable.title: N Usable
n_usable.description: Usable rows (finite size + finite positive price)

n_total.title: N Total
n_total.description: Total rows in the frame (before the usable filter)

spearman_rho.title: Spearman Rho
spearman_rho.description: Spearman rho of size_acres vs listed_price_per_acre_ksh over the full usable frame; null when <2 usable rows

min_group_n.title: Min Group N
min_group_n.description: MIN_GROUP_N from canonical.py (echoed for the UI)

RelationshipsResponse.title: RelationshipsResponse
RelationshipsResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/data/relationships response.

``spearman_rho`` is computed over the FULL usable frame (not the
sample) with ``df.corr(method='spearman')``.  ``deciles`` split the
usable frame into 10 equal-count log-size bins and give each decile's
median price/acre + count.  ``sample`` is a deterministic uniform
random draw of ``RELATIONSHIPS_SAMPLE_N`` rows (seeded) — never top-N
or first-N — so the scatter is unbiased and reproducible.

RelationshipsSamplePoint.title: RelationshipsSamplePoint
RelationshipsSamplePoint.description:
One row of the deterministic uniform sample.

``data_quality_flag`` is the parquet's flag (the 1st-99th percentile
trim); ``is_suspect`` is the Part B gate.  Both are surfaced so the UI's
"hide suspect" toggle and the flag styling both work off the sample.

ScatterPoint.title: ScatterPoint
ScatterPoint.description: One point in the deterministic scatter sample.

n_total.title: N Total
n_total.description: Total filtered rows the sample was drawn from

sample_limit.title: Sample Limit
sample_limit.description: The cap applied (query param scatter_limit, default 400, max 1000)

ScatterSampleBlock.title: ScatterSampleBlock
ScatterSampleBlock.description: Deterministic, UNBIASED random sample of the filtered selection.

ShapGlobalRow.title: ShapGlobalRow
ShapGlobalRow.description:
One row of ``shap_global.csv`` — Cell 9.4 builds one row per
(model, feature) pair for the two tree models (xgb, catboost).

SizeAcresBounds.title: SizeAcresBounds
SizeAcresBounds.description:
Bounds for the parcel-size input, computed from the loaded frame.

Min/max use the 1st / 99th percentile rather than the absolute min /
max so a single extreme outlier (a 0.001-acre error or a 5000-acre
farm) doesn't stretch the supported range.  ``median`` is the 50th
percentile — the frontend can use it as a neutral placeholder hint
rather than typing a fake "1.5".

upper_acres.title: Upper Acres
upper_acres.description: Upper edge (acres); ``null`` for the final open-ended band (the '+inf' tail).  JSON-serialisable alternative to +inf.

median_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Price Per Acre Ksh
median_price_per_acre_ksh.description: Null when n=0 or low_support and no median can be computed

low_support.title: Low Support
low_support.description: True when n < the coverage min_county_n (the same threshold /meta reports).  The frontend draws low-support bands hollow with a tooltip rather than hiding them.

SizeBand.title: SizeBand
SizeBand.description: One vertex on the Price-by-size-band line chart.

median_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Price Per Acre Ksh
median_price_per_acre_ksh.description: Median listed_price_per_acre_ksh across the filtered selection

n_counties_with_data.title: N Counties With Data
n_counties_with_data.description: Distinct counties in the filtered selection

n_counties_meeting_threshold.title: N Counties Meeting Threshold
n_counties_meeting_threshold.description: Distinct counties in the filtered selection with n_listings >= the coverage min_county_n from /meta's coverage rules.

TotalsBlock.title: TotalsBlock
TotalsBlock.description: Aggregate counters + median/IQR for the filtered selection.

intercept.title: Intercept
intercept.description: log(price) at distance=0.  Null when < 2 rows.

r2.title: R2
r2.description: Coefficient of determination.  Null when < 2 rows.

TrendBlock.title: TrendBlock
TrendBlock.description:
Log-linear fit of price per acre against distance over ALL filtered
rows (so the chart's trend line does not depend on the scatter sample).

Model: ``log(price) = slope * distance_km + intercept``.  ``r2`` is the
coefficient of determination of the fit (1.0 = perfect, 0.0 = no
linear relationship, negative = worse than predicting the mean).

VerdictOption.title: VerdictOption
VerdictOption.description:
One verdict + its data-derived definition.

``rule`` carries the REAL thresholds observed in the frame, so the UI
can template "listed at least X% below predicted" without typing a
percentage:

- ``basis`` — "conformal_interval": the verdict reproduces the
  listed-price-vs-interval comparison (below low / within /
  above high) on every row where it could be checked.
- ``match_rate`` — the share of rows where the comparison above
  reproduces the stored verdict (1.0 = exact).
- ``under_ratio_max`` — the maximum listed_over_predicted ratio
  observed among underpriced rows (the empirical cut-off).
- ``over_ratio_min`` — the minimum ratio among overpriced rows.
- ``interval_low_ref`` / ``interval_high_ref`` — the frame column
  names the comparison uses (documented, not magic).

match_rate.title: Match Rate
match_rate.description: Share of rows where the rule reproduces the stored verdict

interval_low_ref.title: Interval Low Ref
interval_low_ref.description: Frame column used as the interval lower bound

interval_high_ref.title: Interval High Ref
interval_high_ref.description: Frame column used as the interval upper bound

n_unknown.title: N Unknown
n_unknown.description: Rows whose verdict is not one of the three known values

n_listings.title: N Listings
n_listings.description: Filtered usable row count (shares are over this)

n_suspect.title: N Suspect
n_suspect.description: Part B suspect-listing gate.  Suspects (listed_over_predicted outside [0.05, 20.0] or non-finite size) are reported here SEPARATELY and EXCLUDED from the underpriced/fair/overpriced counts above.  Shares stay over n_listings (the full filtered usable count).

VerdictsBlock.title: VerdictsBlock
VerdictsBlock.description:
Counts + shares of the stored ``verdict`` column (Underpriced /
Fair / Overpriced).  Shares are computed from the filtered usable
rows and sum (with n_unknown) to n_listings.
